partialUniqueIndexes.name: admin_role_active_unique
partialUniqueIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admin_role_active_unique ON identity.admin_role_assignments USING btree (user_id, role_code) WHERE (revoked_at IS NULL)

partialUniqueIndexes.name: mfa_factors_one_default
partialUniqueIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mfa_factors_one_default ON identity.mfa_factors USING btree (user_id) WHERE (is_default AND (revoked_at IS NULL))

partialUniqueIndexes.name: social_identities_one_per_provider
partialUniqueIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX social_identities_one_per_provider ON identity.social_identities USING btree (user_id, provider) WHERE (unlinked_at IS NULL)

partialUniqueIndexes.name: social_identities_provider_subject
partialUniqueIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX social_identities_provider_subject ON identity.social_identities USING btree (provider, provider_user_id) WHERE (unlinked_at IS NULL)

partialUniqueIndexes.name: user_emails_one_primary
partialUniqueIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_emails_one_primary ON identity.user_emails USING btree (user_id) WHERE is_primary

partialUniqueIndexes.name: user_emails_verified_unique
partialUniqueIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_emails_verified_unique ON identity.user_emails USING btree (email_normal) WHERE (verified_at IS NOT NULL)

partialUniqueIndexes.name: user_phones_one_primary
partialUniqueIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_phones_one_primary ON identity.user_phones USING btree (user_id) WHERE is_primary

partialUniqueIndexes.name: user_phones_verified_unique
partialUniqueIndexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_phones_verified_unique ON identity.user_phones USING btree (phone_e164) WHERE (verified_at IS NOT NULL)

checkConstraints.name: recovery_reviewer_not_subject
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((reviewed_by IS NULL) OR (user_id IS NULL) OR (reviewed_by <> user_id)))

checkConstraints.name: users_username_pair
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((username IS NULL) AND (username_skeleton IS NULL)) OR ((username IS NOT NULL) AND (username_skeleton IS NOT NULL))))

triggers.name: admin_role_dual_approval
triggers.definition: [O] CREATE TRIGGER admin_role_dual_approval BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON identity.admin_role_assignments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION identity.enforce_dual_approval()

triggers.name: komtru_append_only
triggers.definition: [O] CREATE TRIGGER komtru_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON identity.identity_audit_log FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION platform.reject_mutation()

triggers.name: roles_dual_approval_backfill
triggers.definition: [O] CREATE TRIGGER roles_dual_approval_backfill BEFORE UPDATE ON identity.roles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION identity.enforce_dual_approval_backfill()
